v1.coverage: Final seed11 only: legacy bridge truncates stderr for each match.

v2.coverage: Entire C012 run appended range after C011-short-01 end byte, previous byte-range SHA verified.

v3.coverage: Entire C012 run appended range after C011-short-01 end byte, previous byte-range SHA verified.

counterSemantics.published: Successful local offer publications, including all independent reserve groups.
counterSemantics.received: Accepted remote offers at this bus; per-group counts preserve reserve-group identity.
counterSemantics.sent: Successfully queued optional frames including coordinator relays; group_sent counts offers inside those frames.
counterSemantics.imports: Receiver-only branch seed changes; differs from C010 binding consumption count.
counterSemantics.improved: Repaired imported branch immediately improved receiver primary best; not proof of final selected plan or match score gain.
counterSemantics.probe_ns: Total locally measured receiver candidate reevaluation nanoseconds.
counterSemantics.repair_ns: Total locally measured destroy/repair operation nanoseconds when seeding.
counterSemantics.max_receiver_mailbox_age_ms: Maximum local arrival-to-consumption time among observed imported offers, not LAN delay.
counterSemantics.max_stall_ms: Maximum primary-best stagnation seen at receiver checks.
counterSemantics.duplicates: Well-formed old or repeated origin/group revisions ignored.

limitations: All counters are request-close snapshots. The close method does not wait for in-flight workers, and fields are not an atomic multi-field snapshot.
Coordinator log covers final seed11 only; leaf worker logs cover all72 days.
Do not sum frames/offers/imports as unique global solutions: relays and receiver probes intentionally differ.
Request numbers restart each match; use saved worker input sequence and log order to locate a case.
Communication/participation evidence only; root owns scores, formal evaluation and adoption.
